input.instruction: Prepare the confirmed cancellation proposal. schedule_cancellation and cancel_policy target r1 with value {"effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}; use schedule_cancellation for a future date and cancel_policy for today. Report only supplied billing facts, with no payment execution action.

messages.text: I confirmed the billing review yesterday. Please cancel P-123 effective October 31, 2026. I consent to that date, and I want to know the refund amount billing approved.
Do you want the policy canceled today instead?
No, October 31 only. Also, do not say I have received the refund unless the billing record actually shows that.

cancellation_timing.description: Proposed cancellation timing relative to as_of.

active_today.description: Whether the policy remains active as of today before the requested future cancellation.

approved_refund_amount.description: Amount explicitly approved in the supplied billing record, in USD.

refund_status.description: Copy the supplied billing status code.
